description: Send the saved version of a published article over its live post, on the site it is already on, so the post changes at its URL and no second post is added. Edit the article first with replace_article. update_live_post updates the live post in place on WordPress (Rankwise plugin), Next.js (@rankwise/next), Rails (rankwise-rails), the webhook integration and Shopify. On the Rankwise-hosted blog and Framer a saved edit is already live (Framer at its next sync), so there is nothing to push. Webflow, Wix, Notion, Ghost and WordPress.com cannot update a live post from Rankwise: change the post in that CMS by hand. On those sites this call is refused before anything is sent. It runs now and cannot be scheduled. A brief draft must still be approved by its expert. Retries with the same idempotency_key never send twice.
name: update_live_post
title: Update live post
